title: US quarterly equity expiration (September 2027 triple witching) — two sessions after the FOMC decision, undisplaced
source: EST: THIRD-FRIDAY ARITHMETIC, with the convention validated against a live Cboe listing surface rather than assumed. September 2027's third Friday is 2027-09-17 (2027-09-03, -10 and -17 are the month's first three Fridays). The third-Friday convention for this class is validated this session on www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200 after a 301, 1,731 bytes), whose Cboe S&P 500 Variance rows are third Fridays without exception where no holiday intervenes: VA/U6 2026-09-18, VA/V6 2026-10-16, VA/X6 2026-11-20, VA/Z6 2026-12-18, VA/F7 2027-01-15, VA/G7 2027-02-19 and VA/Z7 2027-12-17, each verified a third Friday by weekday arithmetic here; the single exception on that surface, VA/M7 2027-06-17, is the Juneteenth displacement the opex-2027-06-17 entry already documents. NO DISPLACEMENT APPLIES HERE: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, fetched this session) lists the full 2027 NYSE holiday set verbatim — January 1, January 18, February 15, March 26, May 31, June 18, July 5, September 6 (Labor Day), November 25, December 24 — and none falls in September's expiry week, so 2027-09-17 is a full trading day. WHY ESTIMATE AND NOT CONFIRMED: VA/U7 is NOT listed on that surface (the VA curve carries M7 and Z7 but no U7), so this date is arithmetic plus a validated convention, not a listing, and no OCC or Cboe expiration-calendar primary was reached — theocc.com and the cdn.cboe.com expiration-calendar PDF were recorded as 403 by the opex-2027-06-17 lane and were not re-attempted here. Promote on an OCC or Cboe expiration-calendar primary naming 2027-09-17. Discovered during the fomc-2027-09-15 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-2027-09-15 initial research (2026-09-06) because that meeting's +/-5-day corridor returned ZERO tracked events and should not have — this calendar's expiration class simply stops at opex-2027-06-17. WHAT MAKES THIS INSTANCE STRUCTURAL RATHER THAN ROUTINE, measured on the Board's own 2007-2027 calendars: the September FOMC decision has crossed September triple witching, and 2027 is the fourth consecutive year on the new side. Decision-to-third-Friday gaps run 2007 +3, 2008 +3, 2009 -5, 2010 -4, 2011 -5, 2012 +8, 2013 +2, 2014 +2, 2015 +1, 2016 -5, 2017 -5, 2018 -5, 2019 +2, 2020 +2, 2021 -5, 2022 -5, 2023 -5, 2024 +2, 2025 +2, 2026 +2, 2027 +2 — so the decision sat AFTER September expiry in 2021, 2022 and 2023 and sits exactly two sessions BEFORE it in 2024 through 2027, the longest unbroken +2 run in the 21 years parsed (previous best: two, in 2013-2014 and 2019-2020). THE TRAP THAT COMES WITH IT, and it is why this note exists: that +2 shape is exactly the one fomc-2027-03-17 built its 'treat the decision and the expiry as one event window' corridor rule on, and fomc-2027-06-09 withdrew that rule only as 'not this meeting's shape' at +6 — leaving it to reinstate itself the moment a +2 meeting appeared. The fomc-2027-09-15 lane TESTED it on 77 quarterly-month decision days and REFUSED to reinstate it: inside-expiry-week n=49 at mean 1.072% against outside n=28 at 0.844% carries permutation P = 0.163 and REVERSES within September itself (inside 0.795 vs outside 1.092), while the exact +2 subgroup (n=39) runs 0.861% against 0.925% unconditionally — smaller, not larger. Do not re-derive the rule from this entry's date. Impact low; no house playbook is opex- or calendar-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md, grepped by the opex-2027-06-17 lane on 2026-09-05, zero hits). Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
